text: Reproduced on Foundlings #8660: qew pr links 8660 returns "qew: pull request #8660 exists on several targets; pass --target". qew pr links 8660 --target github-github.com-foundlings-foundlings-pr-8660 and --target github-github.com-foundlings-foundlings return the same ambiguity. qew pr link 8660 --related 0450a8kg6 --target github-github.com-foundlings-foundlings-pr-8660 also returns the same error. The item is therefore the existing qew tooling issue; no duplicate filed.
